artifacts.notes: One complete 34-field catalogue record in a declared JSON transport. Not a complete catalogue, original book, manuscript transcription or native liturgical text. Reuse of catalogue data follows CC0-1.0; attribution to the National Library is retained for provenance.
artifacts.rights_basis: National Library of the Czech Republic explicitly dedicates its Online Catalogue of the Slavonic Library (SLK) to CC0-1.0 Universal. Official open-data page https://www.nkp.cz/o-knihovne/odborne-cinnosti/otevrena-data names the 29 August 2023 declaration; the signed declaration https://www.nkp.cz/file/9bf1384644a5a479ff11ae4a517cfc3b/2688/cc0_srpen_2023.pdf names SLK on PDF page 3, with Ministry approval dated 29 August 2023 on pages1–2 (exact policyPDF SHA256 64f1e0b4d4100c298a4332550a7cc59e3aaca3ba1c95642c9c5a8585948bc1fc, 1331534bytes). This payload contains only the complete catalogue DATA table, converted to ordered JSON; software, ExLibris wrapper, scripts, navigation and session links are excluded. The grant does not license Google images, seller photographs or the underlying liturgical book.
